ImageDescription.value:
One of the salesmen at the town square vegetable & fruit market doing business. The market seems to be divided roughly in half between small scale players and larger players with several salespersons (and heated tents during the winter etc.). All in all it's nice to support this form of enterprising, doing away with most middle men that increase the cost for the consumer.
This shot and several others got me really hooked on large apertures at the longer end. Cropped a little, straightened out the frame which was a bit tilted.
